newsitem.title: UK: Granada may sell Sandy Lane this month - paper.
newsitem.headline: Granada may sell Sandy Lane this month - paper.

text.p: Britain's Granada Group Plc is poised to sell one of the world's most exclusive hotels, Barbados's Sandy Lane, to a consortium of Irish investors and an announcement could be made this month, the Sunday Times said.
"Granada Group is close to selling Sandy Lane in Barbados ...to a consortium of Irish investors led by Dermot Desmond, the former stock broker who owns London City Airport," the UK newspaper said.
"Barring last minute hitches, an announcement could be made this month."
Granada inherited Sandy Lane when it completed the 3.9 billion stg acquisition of the Forte hotel and catering empire in January this year.
Granada hopes to complete the sale of the Forte Exclusive hotels by early 1997 after opting not to sell them as a block but to invite offers for individual hotels. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
